Subject is ONLY the ancient Balhae stone lantern at Xinglong Temple, Ning'an. PHOTO2 governs complete geometry, NOT a generic Japanese garden lantern or newly rebuilt temple. Single eight-sided gently curved pavilion-like stone roof, prominent stacked short ringed stone finial above roof. Under shaft is inverted lotus support and low OCTAGONAL decorated solid sumeru base with oval-arch niche reliefs; preserve actual proportions and broken worn edges.
